Fish Cluster

Frames CSV column guide

Each row describes one sampled video frame. A sample is not an independent fish or trial. Coordinates use the original video: X increases rightward and Y downward. Pixels and timestamps are independent of preview zoom. Blank numeric cells mean unavailable, not zero. Centimeters depend on your distance calibration.

Shoaling framesLight/dark framesLight/dark and group summaries

Shoaling frames

The shoaling frames export contains samples included by the count filter, with applied manual corrections. It does not change when you switch the review view. Group IDs apply within one frame; they do not identify individual fish across time.

Columns in export order
ColumnMeaning
frame_indexZero-based sample index, not the source video's native frame number.
timestamp_msRequested sample time in milliseconds from the start of the video.
source_timestamp_msActual decoded image time when experimental intervening-frame processing is enabled. The scheduled sample time stays in timestamp_ms. Blank with ordinary sampled processing.
rawPredictionCountAutomatic candidate count before final selection and manual corrections.
fishCountNumber of current centers used for this frame's measurements.
countDifferenceCurrent count minus expected fish count in background mode. Blank when unavailable.
pairCountNumber of unique pairs: n × (n − 1) / 2.
meanPairDistancePxMean center-to-center distance across all unique pairs, in pixels; blank with fewer than two fish.
meanPairDistanceCentimetersThe same mean pair distance, converted to approximate centimeters.
meanNearestDistancePxMean of each fish's distance to its nearest other fish, in pixels; blank with fewer than two fish.
meanNearestDistanceCentimetersThe same nearest-neighbor mean in approximate centimeters.
closeFishFractionFraction (0–1) of fish with another fish within the selected link distance.
clusterCountNumber of connected groups containing at least two fish. Chains of links form one group.
isolatedCountNumber of single fish with no neighbor within the link distance.
groupSizesGroup sizes sorted largest first, joined by +; for example, 3+1+1.
groupChangedWhether the group-size pattern differs from the preceding exported row. False on the first row. Excluded samples can lie between these rows.
randomSpacingPercentileNearest-neighbor spacing percentile (0–1) against 399 random placements in the usable tank. A small value means tighter spacing. This is a per-frame comparison, not a trial-wide significance test.
randomSpacingUnavailableReasonReason the comparison was suppressed: center-selection or temporal-overlap-estimate. May be blank even when no comparison exists, such as fewer than two centers.
rejectedCandidateCountAutomatic candidates excluded by the center-selection or single-fish contrast rule.
splitCandidateCountCurrent centers produced by splitting a joined blob.
uncertainPositionCountCurrent centers marked uncertain or estimated from a split blob. These can still contribute to shoaling distances.
manualPositionCountCurrent centers supplied by an applied manual correction.
manualCorrectionAppliedTrue when current results use an applied correction. Unapplied drafts do not affect exports.
automaticFishCountOriginal automatic center count before manual correction.
darkSideCountCurrent centers geometrically inside marked dark regions.
lightSideCountCurrent centers geometrically inside marked light regions.
unmarkedSideCountCurrent centers outside marked regions. Shoaling does not infer light from the complement of dark.

Light/dark frames

This export includes all analyzed samples, including excluded or uncertain observations. Mark the dark region; the remaining usable tank is light. Reflection masks are excluded. A reliable side requires exactly one observed or manually corrected center, no ambiguity, and a passing count filter.

Time is estimated over the interval from the first analyzed sample to the last. Each row reports the interval ending at that row. Consecutive reliable positions on the same side assign the whole interval to that side. If the side changes, half goes to each side. Missing or uncertain positions, nonconsecutive samples, excessive time gaps, and unexplained track changes assign the whole interval to unknown. No time is extrapolated before or after the analyzed samples, including the unsampled video tail.

Columns in export order
ColumnMeaning
frame_indexZero-based sample index, preserved even for excluded samples.
timestamp_msSample time in milliseconds from the video's start.
fish_countCurrent number of detected or corrected centers.
included_in_resultsWhether the sample passes the count filter. Passing alone does not guarantee a reliable position.
sidedark, light, or unknown for the current observation.
zone_switchTrue for an observed change from the preceding reliable adjacent sample. Gaps do not create switches. Crossings between samples can be missed.
interval_secondsElapsed seconds since the preceding analyzed sample. Zero on the first row.
dark_time_secondsPortion of this interval assigned to dark. Sum this column for total estimated dark time.
light_time_secondsPortion assigned to light. Sum for total estimated light time.
unknown_time_secondsPortion without reliable zone attribution. Dark + light + unknown equals the reported interval.
x_pxCurrent center's original-video X coordinate when exactly one center exists. Can be present even when side is unknown.
y_pxCurrent center's original-video Y coordinate when exactly one center exists.
speed_px_per_secondStraight-line displacement divided by time over the preceding valid interval. Blank for unavailable intervals or the first row.
speed_centimeters_per_secondThe same scalar speed in approximate centimeters/second using the calibration.
position_sourceHow the single center was obtained, such as observed, manual, or overlap-estimate. Blank without a single center.
position_uncertainWhether that center is flagged uncertain. Such positions do not contribute valid speed or zone intervals.
manual_correction_appliedTrue when current results use an applied correction.
automatic_candidate_countOriginal automatic count before selecting one fish, including rejected candidates.
rejected_candidate_countNumber of candidates excluded from the automatic result. Their original positions remain in the JSON and review.
foreground_contrastMedian foreground brightness difference from the background, in grayscale levels (0–255). Light regions use darkening; dark regions allow either contrast direction. Blank for manual or unavailable measurements.
selection_methodVersioned automatic selection rule, when applied. foreground-next-frame-continuity-v1 means a clear fish in the next sampled frame resolved this frame’s candidates by distance. The JSON records its reference timestamp and the earlier selection.
selection_confidentWhether automatic selection passed its contrast, boundary, or temporal separation rule. This is a heuristic, not a probability. Unresolved competing candidates stay uncertain and do not contribute zone time or speed until resolved or corrected.

Light/dark and group summaries

The per-video summary uses the following fields. Batch exports add trial, exposure, fish ID, source filename and completion status. Saved batch entries are snapshots; after correcting a video, replace its entry to update the group results.

FieldMeaning
darkTimeSecondsTotal estimated time in dark, in seconds.
lightTimeSecondsTotal estimated time in light, in seconds.
unknownTimeSecondsTime without reliable zone attribution.
observedDurationSecondsAnalyzed time span, including unknown time; not necessarily full video duration.
zoneSwitchCountTotal observed adjacent-sample zone changes.
averageSpeedPxPerSecondTotal measured displacement divided by total valid interval time. This is scalar speed, often called velocity in the interface; it is not net directional velocity.
averageSpeedCentimetersPerSecondThe same average in calibrated centimeters/second. Curved movement between samples is not measured.
velocityDurationSecondsTotal duration contributing valid speed measurements.
coverageFraction(Dark time + light time) / analyzed duration, from 0 to 1. Blank if no elapsed interval exists.

Exposure averages are grouped by trial and exposure label, with each saved fish given equal weight. A missing metric is omitted from that metric's average, not counted as zero; the corresponding N reports how many fish contributed. The expected group size is ten, but incomplete groups can be exported. Compare coverage and duration as well as means, especially for partial runs.
